remarks: Great opportunity to buy a move-in ready 2019 built tri-level detached condo in the highly sought-after gated Harvest Community in Upland!  Featuring one of the most desirable floor plans offering 3 bedrooms, and 3.5 bathrooms, including one first level bedroom and bathroom. The second level offers an open floor plan kitchen, living and dining rooms, with a guest bathroom, and a balcony to relax outdoors. A large kitchen with a center island offers counter seating and a great space for entertaining! The primary bedroom and third bedroom and bathroom plus a cozy den are on the third level.
